source: coaching video of one right-handed batter playing every shot, labelled on screen, static cameras; MediaPipe Pose Landmarker (heavy) per frame; cut, repaired, cleaned and retargeted by tools/video_shots/
units: hips offset in leg lengths (hip joint to ankle) from the canonical hips; origin = between the stance feet; +X toward the bowler, +Z the way the batter faces

shots.name: forward_defence
shots.label: front foot defence
why: front foot defence, square on the off side (12.6-18.2 s): long stride to the pitch, front knee over the ball, head over the front foot, back leg stretched out and the back toe dragged; held. The front-on take (seg 0) is clean too but its stride is depth to that camera and came out 2 cm long.

shots.name: back_defence
shots.label: backfoot defence
why: back foot defence, square on the off side: back foot back and across, front foot drawn back beside it, up on the balls of the feet, played under the eyes; clean (no relabelled or muddled frames).

shots.name: straight_drive
shots.label: straight drive
why: straight drive, square on the off side: front foot to the pitch (37 cm stride), head over it, high finish; three muddled frames at 31.30 s (the bat across the legs) replaced from either side.

shots.name: cover_drive
shots.label: cover drive
why: cover drive, square on the off side: clean (no relabelled frames, bone lengths steady), 28 cm stride, weight 52% forward at contact and 63% at the finish, high full follow-through.

shots.name: lofted_drive
shots.label: lofted drive
why: lofted drive, square on the leg side: front foot out (30 cm), deep knee bend, hips and shoulders open hard through a high finish. The other leg-side take (140.3 s) loses the legs' left and right from 140.4 s on (legs crossed in half its frames).

shots.name: back_foot_punch
shots.label: backfoot punch
why: back foot punch, square on the off side: back foot back, front foot drawn back, tall on the toes, short punch.

shots.name: hook
shots.label: hook
why: hook, square on the off side: back foot back and across, pivot on it, the body turning right round to fine leg; the turn is depth to this camera and is the least certain part.

shots.name: pull
shots.label: pull
why: pull, square on the off side: back foot back and across, weight on it, hips round through the shot; clean (no relabelled or muddled frames).

shots.name: sweep
shots.label: sweep
why: sweep, square on the off side (third of four sweeps in the segment): long front stride, back knee right down on the turf, head over the front knee, bat swept along the ground. The 82.3 s take is as good but its back knee lands harder; 89.2 s has 19 muddled frames.

shots.name: slog_sweep
shots.label: slog sweep
why: slog sweep, square on the off side: as the sweep but down on the knee with the bat coming from high and finishing high over the shoulder; the 98.4 s take muddles the legs while kneeling.

shots.name: flick
shots.label: flick
why: flick, square on the leg side: short front stride, wrists rolling the bat to the leg side, hips opening; front-on takes (seg 19, 21) have no clear swing peak and seg 23's stride came out backwards. The leg-side camera saw the stride partly as depth (the front foot came out 50 cm toward the off side): the legs' spread along that camera's line of sight is dropped (the legs kept in the picture's plane, which is nearly the line of the pitch).

shots.name: reverse_sweep
shots.label: reverse sweep
why: reverse sweep, square on the leg side: long front stride, low (no knee down in this take), the bat swept across to the off side.

shots.name: square_cut
shots.label: square cut
why: square cut, square on the leg side: weight back, arms extended through the line, shoulders turning, high finish.

shots.name: late_cut
shots.label: late cut
why: late cut, square on the leg side: back foot across to the off side, the ball played late past the body, low finish.
